title: Top Air Purifiers for Allergies & Pets (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were taken from Good Housekeeping, Consumer Reports, and Tom’s Guide reviews, prioritizing those mentioned by more than one source.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.

verdict.line: Picture a family with a shedding dog using the Blue Pure 311i+ in the living room; it captures dust, pollen, and pet dander efficiently and runs quietly. It is the only model in this guide that is rated best overall by Good Housekeeping and has a large HEPA filter for pet allergens. The catch: it does not have a smart app for remote control.
